verdictRationale: Outcome 'automated_success' indicates compliance requirement is satisfied

registryEntry.label: BYOD Non-Browser Sign-In Failures (Runtime Sample)
registryEntry.get_command: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/auditLogs/signIns?`$filter=clientAppUsed ne 'Browser' and conditionalAccessStatus eq 'failure'&`$top=10&`$orderby=createdDateTime desc").value | Select-Object userPrincipalName,appDisplayName,clientAppUsed,conditionalAccessStatus,createdDateTime | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
evidence_commands: $r = @((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/auditLogs/signIns?`$filter=clientAppUsed ne 'Browser' and conditionalAccessStatus eq 'failure'&`$top=10&`$orderby=createdDateTime desc").value | Where-Object { $_ }); [pscustomobject]@{ count = $r.Count; window = 'the 10 most recent'; signIns = @($r | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ userPrincipalName = $_.userPrincipalName; appDisplayName = $_.appDisplayName; clientAppUsed = $_.clientAppUsed; conditionalAccessStatus = $_.conditionalAccessStatus; createdDateTime = $_.createdDateTime } }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
